name: Geometric Fitness Leggings Look
swap_rule: Reference the look ID. Material, thickness, opacity, pattern and color may be adjusted independently for each garment; keep the garment cuts and construction unchanged.

top.cut: cropped above the waist, three-quarter-length sleeves, rounded neckline
top.construction: black opaque fitted bodice with sheer black mesh inserts across the upper chest, shoulder and upper back; small perforated mesh panels

bottom.cut: close-fitting from waist to ankles, high-rise waistband
bottom.construction: smooth fitted stretch leggings with contrasting pale pink waistband and narrow crisscrossing diagonal ribbon-like graphic bands around thighs and calves
bottom.pattern: dynamic abstract black-and-white brushstroke geometry, layered with narrow pale pink diagonal bands

shoes.construction: lace-up sneakers with contrasting black uppers, patterned white detailing and white soles

view_reference: Front and rear views of the same outfit shown side by side, allowing garment construction and pattern placement to be read from both angles.
